segments.name: Metals Extraction
segments.description: Develops the Kabanga Nickel Project, an exploration and evaluation stage nickel deposit in Tanzania.
segments.evidence: The Metals Extraction segment of the business consists of Lifezone's interest in KNL, comprising the Kabanga Nickel Project ( ''Metals Extraction'' ).

segments.name: Intellectual Property
segments.description: Manages patents, operates Simulus laboratory, develops hydrometallurgical technology and PGM recycling partnership.
segments.evidence: The IP segment comprises patents held and managed by Lifezone Limited, a team of highly skilled engineers, scientists and technicians based in Lifezone's Simulus hydromet laboratory based in Perth, a strategic partnership with Sedibelo Resources Limited ( "SRL" ) and Industrial Development Corporation ( "IDC" ) regarding the development of the potential Kell-Sedibelo-Lifezone Refinery and the agreement between Lifezone and Glencore to recycle PGM in the United States.

segments.name: Corporate
segments.description: Manages group financing, treasury operations and corporate strategy implementation.
segments.evidence: Lifezone's financing and treasury operations are centrally managed at the group level. These activities, along with other group-related functions, are reported under Corporate.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for technical and laboratory services provided by Simulus and for consulting services to joint ventures.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue was attributable to technical consulting services provided to the Kellplant joint venture and technical and laboratory services provided by Simulus.
